title: 'Bote-bote' fuel banned in Ifugao town

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — The municipal government of Lamut in Ifugao has banned the sale, distribution, retailing, and storing of gasoline and other petroleum products in improvised containers, locally known as “bote-bote,” citing fire, explosion, and environmental risks. In a recent public advisory on social media, the local government urged traders and sari-sari store owners to comply with the ordinance, which the Lamut Sangguniang Bayan approved on June 30. The new regulation imposes fines and business permit sanctions on violators.
